ITEM 1 | Waffle-patterned golden-brown baked square, cut into two halves, each with a grid of deep square pockets and crisp browned edges, lying at the bottom of the plate; footprint roughly 25% of plate, about 2 cm thick | 110
ITEM 2 | Bright red cubed fruit, pieces about 1.5 to 2 cm, glossy moist surface with slightly translucent edges, clustered at the upper left of the plate beside the white mass | 75
ITEM 3 | Off-white soft curd-like mass, irregular crumbly chunks and flakes with a matte, slightly moist surface, piled across the center and right of the plate, about 2 to 3 cm tall, covering roughly 40% of the plate | 160
ITEM 4 | Cubed white solid pieces, about 2 cm squares with firmer, smooth-edged faces, scattered among and at the right edge of the curd mass | 50
